_comment: Governance rules for validate_tripwires.py. Merged with the built-in _SEED_POLICY. Keyed by 'owner/repo' or '*' (all repos). Each rule: {id, pattern (python regex, matched case-insensitively against each ADDED diff line), severity (high|medium), message}. Add repo-specific 'never do X' invariants here as they are discovered — this is the cheap, deterministic layer that runs before any LLM.

*.message: force-push to main/master in a diff — never permitted
